verify.subject: Verify your email - Gradix
verify.body: Please verify your email address to activate your account.

reset.subject: Reset your password - Gradix
reset.body: We received a request to reset your password.
reset.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed - Gradix
passwordChanged.body: The password for your Gradix account was changed on {{date}}.
passwordChanged.warning: If this was not you, reset your password immediately and contact your administrator.

roleChanged.subject: Your role has been updated - Gradix

enrolled.subject: New assessment: {{title}}
enrolled.bodyBy: You have been enrolled in {{title}} by {{instructor}}.

accountDeleted.subject: Your Gradix account was deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your Gradix account has been deleted by an administrator. Your personal details were removed; anonymous results may be kept for your institution's records.
accountDeleted.contact: If you think this is a mistake, contact your administrator.

published.subject: Assessment available: {{title}}
published.body: {{title}} is now available. You can start it from your dashboard.
